sections.content: How many people are "company secretaries and administrators"?

3,965 people

were counted on the census as "company secretaries and administrators" in England and Wales in March 2021.

This makes this type of work the fifth least common occupation reported on the census.

Company secretaries (excluding professional/chartered company secretaries) file and maintain company records, translate notes and dictation into typewritten form, and perform other clerical tasks within commercial organisations.

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "company secretaries and administrators" there were more women than men (84.3% compared with 15.7%).

This means "company secretaries and administrators" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "secretarial and related occupations".

Men made up 15.8% and women made up 84.2% of "company secretaries and administrators"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "company secretaries and administrators" included:

  • primary education teaching professionals
  • pharmaceutical technicians
  • senior care workers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally older

The occupation of "company secretaries and administrators" had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 65 years or older. Of the whole working population 4.2% were aged 65 years or older. For people working as "company secretaries and administrators", 18.7% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "company secretaries and administrators" was 16 to 19 years.

Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "company secretaries and administrators" included:

  • managers and proprietors in agriculture and horticulture
  • clergy
  • psychotherapists and cognitive behaviour therapists

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "company secretaries and administrators", 10.9% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work part-time than full-time (52.2% compared with 47.8%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (88.9%) than self-employed (11.1%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Dorset, this is in the region of the South West.
